title: Retire duplicate board/About UI and recover failed privacy changes

source.ref: Bounded runtime orphan graph and retained-feature reconciliation

detail: Removed unrooted BoardControls and CollapsibleAbout after verifying active Crew scope/track controls, Circle tracks/row gates, current shared privacy actions, and HYG-203 safe About richParagraphs replacement. No runtime import or source reader remained, including all-tree relative/newURL searches; historical comments are not live reachability. Fixed both actual privacy controls so refused or transport-rejected writes restore prior accessible state, display a generic safe failure and permit retry. Six actual control interaction tests plus five consumer-removal mutation controls protect retained behavior. No production writes, authenticated browser acceptance or deployment claim.

verify.note: Pins active Crew/Circle scope/track/privacy and safe richtext consumers; exact client interaction tests run in CI.
